display.name: ScyllaDB overview
display.description: Node-level health for ScyllaDB: CPU saturation, CQL throughput, client connections and row cache effectiveness.

display.name: host.name
display.description: List of hosts sending ScyllaDB metrics

display.name: CPU Utilization
display.description: CPU utilization as reported by the ScyllaDB reactor, per node. Sustained values near 100% indicate the node is CPU-bound.

display.name: Served Requests /s
display.description: CQL requests served per second across all client connections.

display.name: CQL Inserts /s
display.description: CQL INSERT statements executed per second, including conditional inserts.

display.name: CQL Updates /s
display.description: CQL UPDATE statements executed per second, including conditional updates.

display.name: CQL Deletes /s
display.description: CQL DELETE statements executed per second, including conditional deletes.

display.name: CQL Batches /s
display.description: CQL BATCH statements executed per second.

display.name: Client Connections
display.description: Number of currently open CQL client connections per node.

display.name: Cache Memory Used
display.description: Bytes currently used by the row cache, per node. Compare against the configured cache capacity.

display.name: Cache Row Hits /s
display.description: Rows served from cache per second. A high ratio against misses indicates a warm, effective row cache.

display.name: Cache Row Misses /s
display.description: Rows not found in cache and read from SSTables per second. Rising misses drive disk latency.
